originalDsl:
@diagram uml-sequence
Sender actor as "Sender"
ChatService participant as "Chat Service"
Queue participant as "Message Queue"
Presence participant as "Presence Service"
PushService participant as "Push Notification Service"
Recipient participant as "Recipient Device"

msg_1 = Sender -#> ChatService as "send message"
msg_2 = ChatService -#> Queue as "enqueue message"
msg_3 = ChatService -#> Presence as "check recipient status"
msg_4 = Presence -.-> ChatService as "recipient offline"
msg_5 = ChatService -#> PushService as "send push notification"
msg_6 = PushService -.-> ChatService as "notification queued"
msg_7 = Queue -#> Recipient as "deliver message"
msg_8 = Recipient -.-> Queue as "delivery ack"
msg_9 = Queue -.-> ChatService as "message delivered"
msg_10 = ChatService -.-> Sender as "delivery receipt"

injectedDefects.description: removed opening quote on label "Chat Service"
